sentences.text: , learned counsel for the petitioner states that against the impugned order dated 26.12.2022 passed under Section 26(2) of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 an appeal is maintainable under Section 17 of the same Act.
Hence, the writ petition is consigned to record with liberty to the petitioner to file an appeal in accordance with law before the appropriate appellate court.

In case any appeal alongwith delay condonation application is filed within one week, the appellate authority shall consider and decide the same in accordance with law within a period of four weeks thereafter.
In case of failure to file the appeal within a period of one week, the benefit of this order will not be available to the petitioner.
